authority: This file is the sole detailed ledger for product-neutral DSH deltas retained after an upstream release merge. The deepseek-harness adoption row and upgrade workflow may reference this file but must not duplicate its entries.

deltas.behavior_obligation: The source plane must not retain generated .js, .js.map, .d.ts, or .d.ts.map siblings for an owning .ts or .tsx source file; module resolution must reach the TypeScript source rather than stale generated output.
verification_commands: node --input-type=module -e "import { existsSync, globSync } from 'node:fs'; const files=globSync('{apps,packages,vendor}/**/src/**/*.{js,js.map,d.ts,d.ts.map}').filter(file=>{const base=file.replace(/(?:\.d\.ts\.map|\.d\.ts|\.js\.map|\.js)$/,''); return existsSync(base+'.ts')||existsSync(base+'.tsx')}); if(files.length){console.error(files.join('\n')); process.exit(1)}"
deltas.retire_when: The upstream release tree and the repository build both preserve this invariant without merge-time cleanup, and an executed repository gate rejects same-name generated source siblings.

deltas.behavior_obligation: read_image must not enqueue a second model-visible image context when the generic Code Mode bridge already forwards the tool image; each read produces one image context injection.
verification_commands: DSH_SNAPSHOT=replay pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.snapshot.config.ts examples/acp-agent/tests/acp.snapshot.ts -t code-mode-read-image
deltas.retire_when: Upstream read_image delegates exclusively to the generic Code Mode image bridge and upstream tests plus an assembled snapshot prove exactly one model-visible image context.

deltas.behavior_obligation: When neither an explicit locale nor a supported browser language exists, Client and Host model-language context must use English as the rc.8 fallback while supported browser language detection still wins.
verification_commands: DSH_SNAPSHOT=replay pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.web.config.ts apps/web/tests/settings-chrome.e2e.ts
deltas.retire_when: The next adopted upstream baseline implements and tests the same English fallback for unsupported browser languages and Host model-language context without a local diff.

deltas.behavior_obligation: Inherited subprocess environments must remove VOYASEEK_HOME case-insensitively together with DSH-owned and credential-shaped variables, while an explicitly supplied child env may intentionally restore a value.
verification_commands: DSH_SNAPSHOT=replay pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.snapshot.config.ts apps/cli/tests/web-browser-open.snapshot.ts
deltas.retire_when: Upstream exposes a product-home environment scrub extension or adopts equivalent case-insensitive sanitization and explicit-child-env semantics with tests.

deltas.behavior_obligation: Statically linked Client inputs remain devDependencies, peer-installed DSH relationships remain peerDependencies plus devDependencies, and neither category leaks into runtime dependencies.
deltas.retire_when: The adopted upstream manifests satisfy verify-client-packages without local dependency-classification changes.

deltas.behavior_obligation: The rebrand scan must skip a tracked path that is deleted from the worktree instead of failing with ENOENT, while still checking every existing tracked non-excluded file and remaining idempotent.
deltas.retire_when: The release importer no longer runs rebrand against a worktree that may contain tracked deletions, or the maintained rebrand implementation provides equivalent missing-path handling with regression coverage.
